title: Read nested user settings
hints: `d.get(key, default)` never raises `KeyError`. Walk down one level at a time: settings first, then ui.
A key can exist but hold `None` (JSON `null`), and then `.get(key, {})` gives you `None`. `profile.get("settings") or {}` covers both cases.
`settings = profile.get("settings") or {}`, `ui = settings.get("ui") or {}`, then `return ui.get("theme", "light"), ui.get("font_size", 14)`.
